**This file discharges handover debt V4.** Part 5 of the handover listed eighteen defects derived by reading v1, never by running it. Each row below is the same claim, measured.

**A refuted row is deleted from the design rationale**, not quietly kept. A design justified by a defect that does not exist is a design without a reason.

**17 reproduced · 0 refuted · 1 blocked**, of 18.

Probe kinds are not equally strong and are labelled so: `executed` ran v1 and read a number; `counted` measured the source text; `blocked` needs something absent and is never reported as a pass. Every `counted` figure is an UPPER bound - the counter drops whole-line comments only, so a name inside a trailing comment is still counted.
